mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN idempotency_key=CONCAT(#{provider},':',#{callback}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE operation='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_RECEIPT' AND target_type='ALERT_NOTIFICATION' AND target_id=CAST(#{notification} AS CHAR) ORDER BY event_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.callbackId')) callback_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.providerCode')) provider_code, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.channel')) channel, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.providerMessageId')) provider_message_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.notificationId')) AS UNSIGNED) notification_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.eventType')) event_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.dtmfDigit')) dtmf_digit,event_time event_time, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.payloadSha256')) payload_sha256,created_at received_at FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE operation='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_RECEIPT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.providerCode'))=#{provider} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail,'$.channel'))=#{channel} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
